title: Sarbacher picks up Townsend Brown after the Paris experiment

tellings.quote: Well, in in 1956 when Thomas Townsen Brown does his um experiment in Paris proving the Biffield Brown effect and that this this works in a vacuum and I think showing some sort of interesting coupling between electromagnetism and gravity. he uh comes back to the US and he's picked up in a black Cadillac by Robert Sarbacher

plain: In 1956, a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have run an experiment in Paris showing that the Biefeld-Brown effect, a push produced by high-voltage electric charge, works even in a vacuum. Michels says this hinted at a link between electromagnetism and gravity, and that when Brown returned to the US he was picked up in a black Cadillac by a man named Robert Sarbacher. Michels tells it himself without naming a source. He tells it because it would suggest that someone in the US was keeping close watch on early work toward controlling gravity.
